title.suggested: Tom Allen's Free Concerts at 619 Market Street

metadata.notes: masthead: St. Louis Daily Globe-Democrat, October 19, 1895

facts.fact: Allen ran a saloon at 619 Market Street, St. Louis, advertising free concerts every evening with first-class singers

notes: Repeat of the 619 Market Street notice (see 916, 920). Whole item is about Allen, so focus primary.
